edges.label: Kean and Blumenthal broke Grusch's crash-retrieval claims
edges.note: On 5 June 2023 they reported Grusch's claim that the US holds a secret UFO retrieval programme with multiple vehicles of non-human origin and records of dead pilots.

edges.label: Co-authors of both defining stories, 2017 and 2023
edges.note: The 16 December 2017 New York Times AATIP story and the 5 June 2023 David Grusch story were both written by Kean and Blumenthal; Helene Cooper was a third author on the 2017 piece.

a.label: New York Times, 'Glowing Auras and Black Money: The Pentagon's Mysterious U.F.O. Program'

edges.label: The New York Times did not publish the 2023 Grusch story
edges.note: The same two authors who wrote the paper's 2017 AATIP revelation took the 2023 crash-retrieval story elsewhere. Recorded as a denial-type edge because the decision not to publish is itself an act by an institution, and one that shaped what the public record looks like.
